title: Another Overworld
description: An additional dimension similar to the overworld
body:
This mod introduces a new dimension that mirrors the Overworld, featuring identical terrain generation, biomes, and structures, providing a familiar yet distinct experience.

Perfect for skyblock modpacks, it adds a fully-fledged Overworld-like dimension alongside your skyblock world, enhancing exploration and gameplay variety.

Access the dimension through a customizable portal, craftable with a unique recipe.
Both the portal's recipe and textures can be tailored using resource packs or data packs, allowing seamless integration into any modpack or server setup.
Ideal for players seeking an authentic Overworld experience in skyblock environments!
